Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block or during any stoppage.
Technical Specifications:

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Eman El Henawey, tested by eng. Wagih Khalil, revised by MDEPC quality control 
eng. Adel El-Naggar, accepted by general manager eng. Ali Zahran, and approved by 
eng. Ahmed Sawwan 
head sector of Nubaria Power Station
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd 
El Gillil MDEPC quality control general manager and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Nageb inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses).
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Brushes
Blower.
Screw driver.
Megger (250-500 V)
Work to be 
carried out
Check power supply for each panel
Surge absorber panel.
Thyristor panel.
Field C.B panel.
Check circuit wiring for:-
Surge absorber panel.
Thyristor panel.
Field CB panel
Measurement of insulation resistance of control and 
alarm circuit for:-
Surge absorber panel.
Thyristor panel.
Field CB panel.
Check for any loose connection cables or parts
Clean all panels
Surge absorber panel.
Thyristor panel.
Field C.B panel.
Check of field circuit breaker.
Check the thyristor fans
Inspection of exterior surface paint
